## Owner-review resolution

The first review gate is resolved: on `2026-08-23`, Grant Wilson approved the
support-normalized arithmetic mean per detector over finite
basis-fit-admitted occurrences within one immutable PTC segment, with binary
centering influence, no numerical reweighting or cross-boundary borrowing,
and fail-closed invalid-support behavior.

The second review gate is also resolved: on `2026-08-23`, Grant Wilson
approved Equation 8's group-local detector-right mask-aware solve with an
explicit finite time-local full-rank guard under frozen tolerance. A deficient
group-time is unavailable for both data and kernel, without partial-rank
subtraction, rank reduction, interpolation, numerical-zero admission, or
cross-group borrowing.

The final gate is resolved: on `2026-08-23`, Grant Wilson answered “approved”
to the complete-packet freeze question. The promotion changes authority status
